youtube.title: Why Thermoses Keep Coffee Hot for Hours ☕ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A thermos, or vacuum flask, is a bottle inside a bottle with the air pumped out between the walls. Heat cannot travel by conduction or convection through a vacuum. The inner glass or steel is coated with a shiny layer that reflects radiated heat back inward. James Dewar invented the vacuum flask in 1892.
